tunguri.visual: small cute orange salamander creature with a tiny smoking volcano cone on its back and glowing ember spots
tunguri.desc: Salamandra nacida en las faldas del Tungurahua. El cráter de su lomo humea cuando se emociona.
tunguri.desc_en: A salamander born on the slopes of Tungurahua. The tiny crater on its back smokes when it gets excited.

tungurak.visual: bipedal red lizard warrior creature with a volcano-shaped crest spewing small flames, dark ash-gray scales with glowing lava cracks
tungurak.desc: Escupe ceniza cuando se enfada. Sus pasos dejan brasas encendidas.
tungurak.desc_en: It spits ash when angry. Its footsteps leave glowing embers.

tungurex.visual: huge fierce volcano dinosaur creature with an erupting volcano crater on its back, black basalt armor plates and rivers of glowing lava
tungurex.desc: Rey de los volcanes andinos. Cuando ruge, la tierra entera retumba.
tungurex.desc_en: King of the Andean volcanoes. When it roars, the whole land rumbles.

yakupi.visual: small cute sea lion pup creature with big shiny eyes, light blue fur and a water droplet on its nose
yakupi.desc: Cría de lobo marino de Galápagos. Juega con las olas todo el día.
yakupi.desc_en: A Galápagos sea lion pup. It plays with the waves all day long.

yakulobo.visual: agile sea lion creature with a wave-shaped fin crest and swirling water around its flippers, deep blue fur
yakulobo.desc: Nada más rápido que una lancha. Dispara chorros con sus aletas.
yakulobo.desc_en: It swims faster than a speedboat and fires jets from its flippers.

yakuaron.visual: massive walrus-like sea lion king creature with icy tusks, frost-covered blue fur and a crown of cold ocean waves
yakuaron.desc: Guardián de la fría corriente de Humboldt. Sus colmillos son de hielo eterno.
yakuaron.desc_en: Guardian of the cold Humboldt Current. Its tusks are made of everlasting ice.

cacaito.visual: small cute round creature shaped like a yellow cacao pod with a leafy sprout on top, tiny legs and a cheerful face
cacaito.desc: Nace de una mazorca de cacao fino de aroma. Huele a chocolate.
cacaito.desc_en: Born from a fine-aroma cacao pod. It smells like chocolate.

cacaoso.visual: sturdy bipedal cacao pod creature with orange-brown husk armor, vine arms and big leaves on its shoulders
cacaoso.desc: Protege las plantaciones de la costa. Lanza semillas amargas.
cacaoso.desc_en: It protects the coastal plantations and hurls bitter seeds.

cacaotor.visual: large powerful dark chocolate golem beast made of cacao pods and twisted roots, with glowing purple eyes and leaf horns
cacaotor.desc: Su cuerpo es de cacao negro. Dicen que un bocado da fuerzas para todo un día.
cacaotor.desc_en: Its body is made of dark cacao. They say one bite gives strength for a whole day.

chispez.visual: small cute electric eel fish creature with yellow lightning stripes, round head and a sparking tail
chispez.desc: Pececito del Amazonas que chispea al reír.
chispez.desc_en: A little Amazon fish that sparks when it laughs.

anguilampo.visual: long electric eel creature floating in the air, dark green body with glowing yellow electric organs and lightning whiskers
anguilampo.desc: Ilumina los ríos de noche. Su descarga ahuyenta a cualquier depredador.
anguilampo.desc_en: It lights up the rivers at night. Its shock scares off any predator.

voltanguila.visual: huge serpent-like electric eel dragon with thunder clouds around it, glowing yellow and teal stripes and a crackling lightning crest
voltanguila.desc: Señora de las tormentas del río Napo. Su rugido suena a trueno.
voltanguila.desc_en: Mistress of the Napo River storms. Its roar sounds like thunder.

quindito.visual: tiny cute hummingbird creature with emerald green feathers, a long thin beak and blurry fast wings
quindito.desc: Los quindes son los colibríes de Ecuador. Este nunca deja de zumbar.
quindito.desc_en: Quindes are Ecuador's hummingbirds. This one never stops buzzing.

quindazo.visual: fierce hummingbird warrior creature with iridescent purple and green feathers, a sword-like beak and long tail streamers
quindazo.desc: Su pico es tan afilado como una espada. Vuela hacia atrás para esquivar.
quindazo.desc_en: Its beak is as sharp as a sword. It flies backwards to dodge.

quindestral.visual: majestic giant hummingbird creature with glowing golden and emerald plumage, star-shaped tail feathers and radiant light wings
quindestral.desc: Inspirado en la estrella del Chimborazo, un colibrí andino. Sus alas dejan estelas de luz.
quindestral.desc_en: Inspired by the Chimborazo hillstar, an Andean hummingbird. Its wings leave trails of light.

galapito.visual: small cute baby giant tortoise creature with a rocky saddle-shaped shell and a sleepy face
galapito.desc: Tortuguita de Galápagos. Puede dormir cien años seguidos.
galapito.desc_en: A tiny Galápagos tortoise. It can sleep for a hundred years straight.

galapon.visual: sturdy giant tortoise creature with a boulder shell covered in moss and small cactus, strong stony legs
galapon.desc: Su caparazón resiste una avalancha. Camina lento pero nunca se detiene.
galapon.desc_en: Its shell withstands an avalanche. It walks slowly but never stops.

galapagon.visual: colossal ancient giant tortoise creature with a volcanic island on its shell, small waterfalls and palm trees growing on its back
galapagon.desc: Tan grande que en su caparazón crecen islas. Es el abuelo del archipiélago.
galapagon.desc_en: So big that islands grow on its shell. It is the grandfather of the archipelago.

chusik.visual: small cute round owl chick creature with dark purple feathers and huge glowing yellow eyes
chusik.desc: Chusik significa lechuza en kichwa. Sus ojos ven en la oscuridad total.
chusik.desc_en: Chusik means owl in Kichwa. Its eyes see in total darkness.

chusikar.visual: sleek shadow owl creature with midnight blue feathers, sharp claws and a mysterious smoky aura
chusikar.desc: Caza sin hacer ruido. Dicen que trae mensajes de la noche.
chusikar.desc_en: It hunts without a sound. They say it carries messages from the night.

chusikron.visual: large majestic dark owl lord creature with wings made of starry night sky and a glowing crescent moon on its forehead
chusikron.desc: Cuando abre sus alas, el día se vuelve noche.
chusikron.desc_en: When it opens its wings, day turns into night.

ukumarito.visual: small cute spectacled bear cub creature with dark fur, cream spectacle markings around the eyes and frost on its ears
ukumarito.desc: Cría de oso de anteojos del páramo. Le encanta la nieve.
ukumarito.desc_en: A spectacled bear cub from the páramo. It loves snow.

ukumari.visual: strong spectacled bear creature with icy blue-tinted fur, frosty spectacle markings and ice crystal claws
ukumari.desc: Ukumari es el oso de las leyendas andinas. Sus garras congelan lo que tocan.
ukumari.desc_en: Ukumari is the bear of Andean legends. Its claws freeze whatever they touch.

ukumarasu.visual: huge glacier bear creature with a back covered in ice crystals and snowy mountain peaks, glowing pale blue spectacle markings
ukumarasu.desc: Duerme bajo los glaciares. Su despertar provoca avalanchas.
ukumarasu.desc_en: It sleeps beneath the glaciers. Its awakening triggers avalanches.

morfito.visual: small cute fuzzy caterpillar creature with glowing blue spots and tiny antennae tipped with light bulbs
morfito.desc: Oruga amazónica que brilla en la oscuridad.
morfito.desc_en: An Amazonian caterpillar that glows in the dark.

crisalux.visual: glowing crystal chrysalis creature floating in the air, golden shell with light shining through cracks and two small eyes
crisalux.desc: Dentro de su crisálida guarda la luz del sol.
crisalux.desc_en: Inside its chrysalis it keeps the light of the sun.

morfolux.visual: magnificent giant blue morpho butterfly creature with shimmering electric-blue wings radiating light and an elegant body
morfolux.desc: La mariposa morfo azul más grande del Amazonas. Sus alas deslumbran.
morfolux.desc_en: The largest blue morpho of the Amazon. Its wings are dazzling.

llamin.visual: small cute fluffy baby llama creature with a little flame on its fluffy head tuft and colorful Andean tassels on its ears
llamin.desc: Una llamita con llama. Su lana siempre está calentita.
llamin.desc_en: A little llama with a flame. Its wool is always warm.

llamaradon.visual: proud adult llama creature with a blazing fire mane, a colorful woven Andean blanket and hot wind swirling around its hooves
llamaradon.desc: Escupe fuego en vez de saliva. Corre por los Andes como el viento.
llamaradon.desc_en: It spits fire instead of saliva and runs across the Andes like the wind.

dardin.visual: tiny cute poison dart frog creature, bright blue with black spots and a leaf on its head
dardin.desc: Ranita venenosa del bosque. Su color avisa: ¡no me toques!
dardin.desc_en: A tiny poison frog of the forest. Its colors warn: don't touch me!

dardosa.visual: sleek poison dart frog creature with a vivid red and black pattern, dripping purple venom and a leaf-shaped crest
dardosa.desc: Su piel tiene suficiente veneno para dormir a un jaguar.
dardosa.desc_en: Its skin has enough venom to put a jaguar to sleep.

pinzin.visual: small cute red mangrove crab creature with one big claw and a bubbly mouth
pinzin.desc: Vive entre las raíces del manglar. Pellizca a quien se acerca.
pinzin.desc_en: It lives among the mangrove roots and pinches anyone who gets close.

pinzaglar.visual: large armored mangrove crab creature with a stone-like shell, mangrove roots growing on its back and two huge claws
pinzaglar.desc: Sus pinzas parten troncos. Defiende el manglar como una fortaleza.
pinzaglar.desc_en: Its claws split logs. It defends the mangrove like a fortress.

piranin.visual: small cute round piranha fish creature with a sharp-toothed grin, red belly and tiny fins, floating in the air
piranin.desc: Pequeño pero muy mordelón. Nunca anda solo.
piranin.desc_en: Small but very bitey. It never travels alone.

piranazo.visual: fierce large piranha creature with dark scales, glowing red eyes, huge jaws full of teeth and shadowy fins
piranazo.desc: Huele el miedo desde lejos. Su mordida atraviesa armaduras.
piranazo.desc_en: It smells fear from afar. Its bite pierces armor.

capibin.visual: small cute chubby capybara creature with a lily pad on its head and a calm sleepy smile
capibin.desc: El Primal más tranquilo del río. Todos quieren ser su amigo.
capibin.desc_en: The calmest Primal in the river. Everyone wants to be its friend.

capibaron.visual: big relaxed capybara creature wearing a crown of water lilies, with small birds resting on its back and a river splash
capibaron.desc: Nada sin prisa y nunca pierde la calma. Hasta los pájaros descansan sobre él.
capibaron.desc_en: It swims at its own pace and never loses its cool. Even birds rest on it.

pelusin.visual: small cute fuzzy tarantula creature with dark purple hair, many shiny eyes and tiny fangs
pelusin.desc: Una tarántula peludita y tímida. Teje telarañas con forma de estrella.
pelusin.desc_en: A shy fuzzy tarantula. It weaves star-shaped webs.

taranton.visual: large tarantula creature with rocky armored legs, dark violet fur and glowing purple fangs
taranton.desc: Vive en las cuevas de la Amazonía. Sus patas son duras como la piedra.
taranton.desc_en: It lives in Amazon caves. Its legs are as hard as stone.

piquerito.visual: small cute seabird chick creature with fluffy white down and very big bright blue feet, blue-footed booby
piquerito.desc: Presume sus patas azules. Baila para hacer amigos.
piquerito.desc_en: It shows off its blue feet and dances to make friends.

patazul.visual: elegant blue-footed booby bird creature with wings spread, white and brown feathers and vivid turquoise feet
patazul.desc: Se lanza en picada al mar como una flecha. Su baile es famoso en Galápagos.
patazul.desc_en: It dives into the sea like an arrow. Its dance is famous in Galápagos.

iguanin.visual: small cute yellow land iguana creature with a spiky orange crest and a warm glowing belly
iguanin.desc: Toma el sol sobre rocas volcánicas hasta brillar.
iguanin.desc_en: It sunbathes on volcanic rocks until it glows.

iguanarca.visual: large golden land iguana creature with a crest of flaming cactus spines and prickly pear cactus growing on its back
iguanarca.desc: Come cactus y respira fuego. Gobierna las islas secas.
iguanarca.desc_en: It eats cactus and breathes fire. It rules the dry islands.

frailito.visual: small cute fuzzy frailejon plant creature with a rosette of silvery hairy leaves on its head and tiny stubby legs
frailito.desc: Pequeña planta del páramo cubierta de pelusa para no tener frío.
frailito.desc_en: A small páramo plant covered in fuzz so it never gets cold.

frailejon.visual: tall frailejon plant creature with a thick trunk body, a frosty silver leaf crown and yellow flowers, covered in morning frost
frailejon.desc: Guardián del agua del páramo. Atrapa la niebla y la vuelve ríos.
frailejon.desc_en: Guardian of the páramo's water. It catches the mist and turns it into rivers.

aullin.visual: small cute howler monkey creature with reddish fur, a curly tail and tiny sparks around its open mouth
aullin.desc: Su grito se oye a kilómetros. Se carga de electricidad al gritar.
aullin.desc_en: Its howl can be heard for miles. Howling charges it with electricity.

aullatrueno.visual: large howler monkey creature with storm cloud fur, lightning bolts in its mane and a long thunder tail
aullatrueno.desc: Cuando aúlla, empieza a llover. Es el dueño de las copas de los árboles.
aullatrueno.desc_en: When it howls, the rain begins. It owns the treetops.

tucanin.visual: small cute toucan chick creature with a huge colorful orange beak and fluffy black and white feathers
tucanin.desc: Su pico casi no pesa, aunque parezca enorme.
tucanin.desc_en: Its beak weighs almost nothing, even though it looks huge.

tucanazo.visual: large majestic toucan creature with a blazing rainbow beak glowing like fire and black feathers with flame-colored tips
tucanazo.desc: Su pico arde con los colores del atardecer amazónico.
tucanazo.desc_en: Its beak burns with the colors of the Amazon sunset.

otoronguito.visual: small cute black jaguar cub creature with faint rosette spots and glowing green eyes
otoronguito.desc: Cachorro de otorongo, el jaguar del Amazonas. Juega a cazar sombras.
otoronguito.desc_en: A cub of the otorongo, the Amazon jaguar. It plays at hunting shadows.

otorongo.visual: powerful black jaguar creature with glowing jungle-green rosettes, vines wrapped around its legs and fierce eyes
otorongo.desc: Rey de la selva. Aparece y desaparece entre las hojas.
otorongo.desc_en: King of the jungle. It appears and vanishes among the leaves.

amaruto.visual: small cute young anaconda snake creature with green and black spotted scales, coiled up with a friendly face
amaruto.desc: Amaru es la serpiente sagrada de los Andes. Esta todavía es pequeña.
amaruto.desc_en: Amaru is the sacred serpent of the Andes. This one is still small.

amarusacha.visual: giant anaconda creature coiled in a river, mossy green scales with water lilies and jungle vines growing on its body
amarusacha.desc: La anaconda más grande del río. Sostiene la selva sobre su espalda.
amarusacha.desc_en: The largest anaconda in the river. It holds the jungle on its back.

bufeito.visual: small cute pink river dolphin creature with a long snout, playful smile and bubbles
bufeito.desc: Delfín rosado del Amazonas. Le encanta hacer piruetas.
bufeito.desc_en: A pink Amazon river dolphin. It loves doing flips.

bufeorosa.visual: elegant large pink river dolphin creature glowing with mystical light and sparkling water ribbons around it
bufeorosa.desc: La leyenda dice que de noche se convierte en persona y va a las fiestas.
bufeorosa.desc_en: Legend says that at night it turns into a person and goes to parties.

harpin.visual: small cute fluffy harpy eagle chick creature with gray feathers and a double crest
harpin.desc: Pichón de águila harpía. Ya mira como un cazador.
harpin.desc_en: A harpy eagle chick. It already has a hunter's stare.

harpiandina.visual: mighty harpy eagle creature with huge talons, gray and black feathers, a majestic double crest and leaves swirling in the wind
harpiandina.desc: El ave más fuerte del bosque. Sus garras son como garfios.
harpiandina.desc_en: The strongest bird of the forest. Its talons are like hooks.

pingui.visual: small cute Galapagos penguin chick creature, gray and fluffy with a white face stripe and icy blue flippers
pingui.desc: Uno de los pocos pingüinos que viven en la línea ecuatorial.
pingui.desc_en: One of the few penguins that live on the Equator.

galapingo.visual: sleek penguin warrior creature sliding on ice, black and white with frost patterns and a cold water splash
galapingo.desc: Patina sobre el mar y congela las olas a su paso.
galapingo.desc_en: It skates over the sea, freezing the waves as it goes.

martillin.visual: small cute baby hammerhead shark creature with a wide hammer-shaped head and tiny fins, floating in the air
martillin.desc: Tiburón martillo bebé. Se golpea la cabeza con todo, pero no le duele.
martillin.desc_en: A baby hammerhead shark. It bumps its head on everything, but it doesn't hurt.

martillazo.visual: huge hammerhead shark creature with a stone-armored hammer head, gray-blue body and a powerful tail, ocean splashes
martillazo.desc: Patrulla las aguas de Galápagos. Su cabeza parte rocas.
martillazo.desc_en: It patrols the waters of Galápagos. Its head smashes rocks.

atuk.visual: small cute Andean fox kit creature with gray-red fur, a bushy tail with a frosty tip and big ears
atuk.desc: Atuk significa zorro en kichwa. Es travieso y muy listo.
atuk.desc_en: Atuk means fox in Kichwa. It is mischievous and very clever.

atukrasu.visual: sleek páramo fox creature with frosty silver fur, dark shadowy tail tips and glowing icy eyes, snowflakes swirling
atukrasu.desc: El zorro fantasma del páramo. Deja huellas de escarcha.
atukrasu.desc_en: The ghost fox of the páramo. It leaves frosty footprints.

pumita.visual: small cute puma cub creature with tan fur, stone pebbles on its paws and curious eyes
pumita.desc: Cachorro de puma que juega entre las piedras.
pumita.desc_en: A puma cub that plays among the rocks.

pumarumi.visual: powerful mountain puma creature with stone armor plates like Inca walls on its shoulders and wind swirling around its tail
pumarumi.desc: Rumi significa piedra. Su armadura recuerda a los muros incas.
pumarumi.desc_en: Rumi means stone. Its armor recalls the Inca walls.

tapirin.visual: small cute mountain tapir calf creature with striped and spotted fur, a short trunk and leaves on its back
tapirin.desc: Cría de tapir de montaña. Sus rayas desaparecen al crecer.
tapirin.desc_en: A mountain tapir calf. Its stripes fade as it grows.

tapiramo.visual: large woolly mountain tapir creature with mossy stone armor, a flexible trunk and ferns growing on its back
tapiramo.desc: Siembra el bosque nublado con cada paso.
tapiramo.desc_en: It plants the cloud forest with every step.

vicunin.visual: small cute fluffy vicuna creature with golden wool, a long neck and a frosty white bib
vicunin.desc: Su lana es la más fina del mundo.
vicunin.desc_en: Its wool is the finest in the world.

vicunieve.visual: graceful vicuna creature running, golden and white wool with ice crystals and a cold wind trailing behind it
vicunieve.desc: Corre por las faldas del Chimborazo a la velocidad del viento.
vicunieve.desc_en: It runs along the slopes of Chimborazo as fast as the wind.

fragatin.visual: small cute frigatebird chick creature with black feathers and a tiny red throat pouch
fragatin.desc: Infla su buche rojo para presumir.
fragatin.desc_en: It puffs up its red pouch to show off.

fragatormenta.visual: large frigatebird creature with long sharp black wings crackling with lightning and a huge inflated glowing red pouch
fragatormenta.desc: Roba la comida a otras aves en pleno vuelo, y también los rayos.
fragatormenta.desc_en: It steals food from other birds in mid-flight, and lightning too.

cuernin.visual: small cute beetle larva creature with a tiny horn, a brown shell and stubby legs
cuernin.desc: Larva de escarabajo. Ya es fortísima.
cuernin.desc_en: A beetle larva. It is already super strong.

hercularmor.visual: giant hercules beetle creature with a long shiny horn, metallic olive armor shell and electric sparks between its horn tips
hercularmor.desc: Levanta cien veces su peso. Su cuerno conduce la electricidad.
hercularmor.desc_en: It lifts a hundred times its weight. Its horn conducts electricity.

cristalin.visual: small cute glass frog creature with transparent lime-green skin showing a glowing heart and big golden eyes
cristalin.desc: Rana de cristal: se le ve el corazón brillar.
cristalin.desc_en: A glass frog: you can see its heart glowing.

ranacristal.visual: elegant glass frog creature with a crystal-clear body refracting rainbow light, water droplets and a leaf perch
ranacristal.desc: Su cuerpo de cristal separa la luz como un prisma.
ranacristal.desc_en: Its crystal body splits light like a prism.

caimancito.visual: small cute baby black caiman creature with dark scales, yellow eyes and a toothy smile
caimancito.desc: Cría de caimán negro. Se esconde con solo los ojos fuera del agua.
caimancito.desc_en: A black caiman hatchling. It hides with only its eyes above the water.

caimanegro.visual: huge black caiman creature with dark armored scales, glowing yellow eyes and shadowy swamp water around it
caimanegro.desc: El gran cazador de las lagunas amazónicas.
caimanegro.desc_en: The great hunter of the Amazon lagoons.

ayahuma.visual: fearsome Diablo Huma mask spirit creature with a two-faced colorful mask, horns, long colorful ribbons and a fiery dark aura, Andean festival dancer
ayahuma.desc: Espíritu del baile del Inti Raymi. Tiene dos caras: una mira al pasado y otra al futuro.
ayahuma.desc_en: The spirit of the Inti Raymi dance. It has two faces: one looks to the past, the other to the future.

cotopaxin.visual: cute small volcano creature shaped like a perfect snow-capped cone with a glowing lava heart and little feet
cotopaxin.desc: Un volcancito con gorro de nieve. Hierve por dentro.
cotopaxin.desc_en: A little volcano wearing a snow cap. It boils inside.

cotopaxor.visual: colossal volcano titan creature with a perfect snow-capped cone head erupting fire, lava rivers and glaciers on its body
cotopaxor.desc: El volcán nevado más famoso cobra vida. Fuego y hielo en un solo cuerpo.
cotopaxor.desc_en: The most famous snowy volcano comes to life. Fire and ice in a single body.

quiloton.visual: mysterious turquoise crater lake spirit creature, a round serpent coiled like a lagoon with an emerald water body and volcanic rim armor
quiloton.desc: Duerme en el fondo de la laguna del Quilotoa. Su color cambia con el sol.
quiloton.desc_en: It sleeps at the bottom of the Quilotoa lagoon. Its color changes with the sun.

tunda.visual: eerie jungle forest spirit creature with a twisted wooden body, mossy hair, one leg like a tree root and glowing eyes
tunda.desc: Espíritu de las leyendas de Esmeraldas. Confunde a quien se pierde en el bosque.
tunda.desc_en: A spirit from the legends of Esmeraldas. It confuses anyone lost in the forest.

gallofierro.visual: proud iron rooster creature made of wrought iron and gold, a weathervane tail and a glowing sunrise crest
gallofierro.desc: El gallo de hierro de la catedral de Cuenca. Cuando canta, sale el sol.
gallofierro.desc_en: The iron rooster of Cuenca's cathedral. When it crows, the sun rises.

iguamarina.visual: marine iguana creature with black spiky scales, a salty white crest and sea spray
iguamarina.desc: Iguana marina que estornuda sal. Bucea entre corales.
iguamarina.desc_en: A marine iguana that sneezes salt. It dives among corals.

draconarina.visual: huge sea dragon iguana creature with black volcanic scales, a steaming red crest, ocean waves and fire around it
draconarina.desc: Mitad dragón, mitad iguana marina. Hace hervir el mar.
draconarina.desc_en: Half dragon, half marine iguana. It makes the sea boil.

lumbron.visual: glowing firefly beetle creature with a big bright yellow-green lantern abdomen and sparkles
lumbron.desc: Luciérnaga gigante que guía a los viajeros perdidos.
lumbron.desc_en: A giant firefly that guides lost travelers.

lumbrestrella.visual: majestic star firefly creature with crystal wings, a radiant star-shaped lantern and electric light trails
lumbrestrella.desc: Su luz se ve desde el espacio. Dicen que es una estrella que bajó.
lumbrestrella.desc_en: Its light can be seen from space. They say it is a star that came down.

rayuku.visual: thunderbird creature with wings made of storm clouds, lightning feathers and glowing yellow eyes
rayuku.desc: Ave del trueno de los Andes. Sus alas traen las tormentas.
rayuku.desc_en: The thunderbird of the Andes. Its wings bring the storms.

rasuwawa.visual: small yeti-like snow creature with fluffy white fur, an icy blue face and a woven Andean hat
rasuwawa.desc: Wawa significa bebé. Este pequeño vive en la nieve eterna.
rasuwawa.desc_en: Wawa means baby. This little one lives in the everlasting snow.

rasuruna.visual: giant snow guardian creature with glacier ice armor shining in the sunlight, white fur, an Andean poncho and a glowing crystal staff
rasuruna.desc: Rasu es nieve y runa es gente: el guardián de los glaciares.
rasuruna.desc_en: Rasu means snow and runa means people: the guardian of the glaciers.

jorobin.visual: cute baby humpback whale creature with long white flippers, a bumpy head and a happy water spout
jorobin.desc: Ballenato que llega a Puerto López cada año.
jorobin.desc_en: A whale calf that arrives at Puerto López every year.

jorobalena.visual: huge majestic humpback whale creature leaping, long flippers like wings, barnacles and a powerful blowhole spout
jorobalena.desc: Su canto se escucha a cientos de kilómetros. Salta como si volara.
jorobalena.desc_en: Its song can be heard hundreds of miles away. It leaps as if it could fly.

sacharuna.visual: ancient jungle giant creature made of trees, stones and roots, with a mossy face, glowing seeds and birds nesting on its shoulders
sacharuna.desc: El hombre de la selva. Cuida a los animales del bosque.
sacharuna.desc_en: The wild man of the jungle. It protects the forest animals.

sangayon.visual: furious volcano beast creature with an always-erupting crater on its back, a black rock body and a constant ash cloud
sangayon.desc: El volcán Sangay nunca descansa, y él tampoco.
sangayon.desc_en: Sangay volcano never rests, and neither does it.

chimbila.visual: mysterious vampire bat creature with large purple membranous wings, glowing red eyes and a smoky shadow trail
chimbila.desc: Murciélago de las cuevas de Jumandy. Solo sale con luna nueva.
